claim: Stem "Lựa chọn nào không được ngụ ý bởi sơ đồ lớp minh họa dưới đây?" is answerable from the pack's attached media.
found: The stem requires the class diagram shown in the source (Quiz 0704 Q1: box 'Teacher  2 ──teaches▷── 0..3  Course', with the answer hinging on the 'Teacher 2' multiplicity). The pack attaches images[0] id=svg-sdlc, alt='Vòng đời phát triển phần mềm (SDLC)' — an unrelated SDLC life-cycle diagram. The referenced diagram is absent, so the question is unanswerable/misleading as presented (the options talk about teachers/courses but no diagram shows them).
fix: Either attach a faithful SVG of the source class diagram (Teacher 2 ──teaches▷── 0..3 Course), or drop the question like the other figure-dependent LMS items (pp.113/114/123/124/137/254/257).

claim: Stem "Phát biểu nào sau đây về biểu đồ class sau là đúng?" is answerable from the pack's attached media.
found: The source (Question 5, page 3/12) shows a class diagram of two classes A and B joined by an aggregation (open-diamond) association; the correct option c refers to that specific relationship. The pack attaches images[0] id=svg-sdlc, alt='Vòng đời phát triển phần mềm (SDLC)' (an unrelated SDLC diagram). The referenced class diagram is absent/misleading.
fix: Attach a faithful SVG of the source class diagram (A ◇── B aggregation), or exclude the item like the other figure-dependent questions. Also add an accurate alt.

source_file: Công nghệ phần mềm - quiz 100 câu.pdf
claim: Stem "Ký hiệu sau được sử dụng trong biểu đồ UML nào?" ("which UML diagram uses the following symbol?") is answerable from the pack's attached media.
found: The stem refers to a symbol ('Ký hiệu sau') that is NOT present anywhere in the source print: page 37 shows the stem, then only the generic MS-Forms immersive-reader icon (identical on every question), then the options; there is no embedded raster image and no vector symbol on the page (pymupdf get_images/get_drawings empty of any figure). The source answer radio is option A 'Biểu đồ hoạt động' but the referenced notation is missing. The pack attaches images[0] id=svg-uml-overview, alt='Phân loại biểu đồ UML' — a generic UML-overview diagram, not the referenced symbol. The question is unanswerable/misleading as a figure reference.
fix: Exclude the item (like the other 'Hình sau…'/'ký hiệu' figure questions) or, if the original symbol can be recovered from the live MS Form, embed it; do not substitute an unrelated generic diagram.

claim: "### Phân tích từng lựa chọn" analyses each distractor; "### Lời giải từng bước"/"### Điểm dễ nhầm" justify the stem.
found: Explanations are per-topic templates. Of 1635 per-choice lines, 1435 (~88%) are pure boilerplate ('Sai: không khớp với kiến thức đúng của chủ đề …' / 'Đúng: đây là phương án nguồn đánh dấu là đáp án') that does not analyse the specific distractor. The 'Lời giải' and 'Điểm dễ nhầm' blurbs are chosen by one tag and are often off-topic for the stem, e.g. gk20242-003 (a UML class-diagram question, tag 'tong-quan') gets a 'software vs program' blurb; lms-008 ('Chi phí nào tốn kém nhất…') gets WBS/critical-path blurb; lms-031 ('Cách tiếp cận nào… sau mỗi lần lặp', answer Agile, tag 'cau-hinh') gets an SCM/Git snapshot blurb; lms-270 (a requirements question) gets 'Điểm dễ nhầm: QA ≠ QC'. The marked answers themselves are correct (verified against source); only the prose is low-value/off-topic.
fix: Generate per-choice analysis from the actual distractor semantics and make the step-by-step/Điểm-dễ-nhầm text conditional on the real stem topic (and correct the tag for gk20242-003, which is a UML question tagged 'tong-quan').

source_file: Công nghệ phần mềm - quiz LMS.pdf
claim: Pack stem is verbatim the source stem.
found: Pack stem: 'Mô tả phù hợp cho câu lệnh: {\$ git branch dev}?' vs source: 'Mô tả phù hợp cho câu lệnh: {$ git branch dev}?'. The '$' is escaped as '\$' (deliberate LaTeX escaping; renders as '$'). All other stems/options are verbatim (0 differences across 424).
fix: No change required if the escaping is intentional (it prevents the app's $…$ math parsing); otherwise use a code span/backticks instead of '\$'.

claim: Each question's image illustrates its topic.
found: 31 hand-drawn SVGs are shared by topic tag, heavily re-used (svg-sdlc ×97, svg-design-principles ×37, svg-gantt ×33 …). For non-figure questions these are decorative, but some are topically unrelated to the stem (e.g. an SDLC diagram on 'Giá thành phần mềm ngày càng giảm?', a Gantt diagram on 'Sản phẩm nào KHÔNG phải … ?'). SVGs are all self-contained, well-formed, have xmlns and accurate alt text; no src/ascii media.
fix: Optional: hide the decorative image when it is unrelated to the stem, or map images by finer-grained sub-topic.
